notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.17.7. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `ownedRelatedElement += ActionBodyParameter` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. It contributes no tokens; the braces of a branch or loop body belong to ActionBodyParameter below it. It is the member that puts a body in a parameter position, which is what makes the body of an if or a loop an argument of the node rather than a nested namespace.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.
The braced body opened on line 7 by `if i < 0 {` is held by this member, as is the else body opened on line 11 and the loop body on line 20.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
